signature.name: VTask.mkHom
signature.type:
{V : Type u} -> [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} V] -> [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms V] -> (P Q : CochainComplex V ℕ) -> (zero : P.X 0 ⟶ Q.X 0) -> (one : P.X 1 ⟶ Q.X 1) -> (one_zero_comm : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp zero (Q.d 0 1) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (P.d 0 1) one) -> (succ :
    (n : ℕ) →
      (p :
          (f : P.X n ⟶ Q.X n) ×'
            (f' : P.X (n + 1) ⟶ Q.X (n + 1)) ×'
              CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (Q.d n (n + 1)) =
                CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (P.d n (n + 1)) f') →
        (f'' : P.X (n + 2) ⟶ Q.X (n + 2)) ×'
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p.snd.fst (Q.d (n + 1) (n + 2)) =
            CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (P.d (n + 1) (n + 2)) f'') -> P ⟶ Q

conventions.statement: The differential `d i j` of the cochain complex is zero whenever `j ≠ i + 1`; consequently the commutativity condition for the chain map is vacuous for non-consecutive index pairs and the constructor only enforces it for pairs `(n, n+1)`.
conventions.note: Standard Mathlib convention for HomologicalComplex differentials.
